name: Café Sydney
lede: From the top of Customs House, Café Sydney looks out over the harbour. Its manager chose Platinum gas heaters after seeing them at another venue, because they visually recede when off.
beats: Café Sydney sits on the top of Customs House at Circular Quay, with a large outdoor dining terrace over the harbour.
The terrace needed heat that would not spoil the view or the room when it was switched off.
The manager chose Platinum Smart-Heat gas heaters after seeing them elsewhere. Whether they are still installed, and how many, is to confirm.
